title: The Role of the Therapeutic Relationship in Osteopathic Treatment from the Patients’ Perspective
summary: In many therapeutic approaches, the relationship between therapist and patient plays an important role in treatment outcomes. The way patients themselves experience this relationship appears to be particularly crucial for its effectiveness. While the therapeutic relationship has been well studied in psychotherapy and, increasingly, in medical contexts, there is still little research in the field of osteopathy. This study explores how important patients perceive their relationship with their osteopaths, which characteristics they associate with a good therapeutic relationship, and whether there are links between patient and practitioner characteristics and patients’ evaluations of the relationship.
conditions: Investigation of the Therapeutic Relationship in Osteopathic Treatment

interventions.name: Patients currently in osteopathic treatment (within the past month).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Currently (within the past month) receiving osteopathic treatment
Sufficient German or English language skills to understand the instructions
Consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
There are no additional exclusion criteria; participants are excluded only if they do not meet the inclusion criteria.
